contexts.text: In consequence of punishments the internals at last abstain from infestation... but they cannot abstain unless they apply their whole strength to remove themselves. Signified.
Divine influx with those who had abstained from evils. Signified.
Man can abstain from evils of himself. Explained.
Necessity of man's abstaining from evil.
Abstaining from adulteries from fear of the civil law, etc. CL 153, General article.
Times of abstinence required after childbirth.
These, if of will and understanding they abstain from one evil because it is a sin, they abstain from all.
Abstinence from doing does not constitute chastity, but abstinence from willing, when he is able [to do], because it is a sin. Explained.
Everyone is regenerated by abstaining from evils of sin...
From fear of eternal punishment abstains from it...
If afterwards he abstains from one or another sin...
When he then resists and abstains...
